body:
Thank you @ankit27kh! This is a great addition to have. 💯 

It'd be good to add tests for the `to_autograd`, `to_tf` and `to_torch` functions as well, to make sure that the "best" diff method is passed there even if it's been changed in the QNode. And don't forget to update the changelog.
Thanks for addressing my comments. Just have a few suggestions for improvements for the tests!

This is looking good @ankit27kh! As soon as the edge-case that @antalszava mentioned is fixed, and tests are added for that, this will be getting ready to be merged. Let us know if you're having any issues with how to proceed.

Thank you @ankit27kh. We're very glad that you enjoyed the event. You're very welcome to keep contributing to PennyLane in the future as well. We hope to see many more contributions!

> About this, I was also confused. Perhaps we're missing something simple.

Yes, the issue seems to have to do with these particular tests being skipped. The `importskip` statement should attempt to import `tensorflow` rather than `tf`. Hopefully it'll work now! 🙂
